regime_context: This is a mean-revert regime in the Hong Kong theme set: the absolute-trend gate is the only validated leg and it currently clears only 4 of 17 themes (narrow breadth, frac 0.24), while the leader Banks (H + HK) is heavily one-trade crowded (crowding_z 1.02, crowded true) with a mean-revert hurst tag. Momentum rank is display-only, rotation has no forward edge, and all but two themes are unscorable, so the honest posture is a very small handful of low-conviction directional leans, not a buy list.
emerging_watch: Watch whether the one-narrative breadth stays narrow (eligible frac 0.24). The condition that retires the watch: on a future snapshot the eligible count rises to 8 or more of 17 with two consecutive non-crowded trend-tagging themes, indicating a broadening out of the mean-revert regime into a durable trend.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks are the only eligible theme with strong breadth (0.769) and a leadership rank of 1, so the trend-gate leg validates its staying power; however the mean-revert hurst tag and crowded flag (crowding_z 1.02) mean any lean must be size-downed, and with no scorable ETF proxy this is a judgement call on narrative durability rather than a verified edge.
evidence: breadth 0.769, the widest among eligible themes
trend-gate eligibility (gate_helps true) — only validated drawdown leg
crowded true, crowding_z 1.02 — size-down caution, not a fade
theses.dissent: The mean-revert hurst tag on the leader, combined with crowding, suggests the theme is already well-owned and may be prone to a shake-out; the narrow eligible breadth (4/17) implies leadership is fragile and not a durable trend.

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) gives back its entire 30-day leadership spread to the Hang Seng benchmark and ends below the next 4 ineligible themes on the next snapshot.

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the only challenger (rank 2, score 1.155) with a trend hurst tag, non-crowded texture (crowding_z 0.24), and eligibility via the trend gate; it is the cleaner trend-following candidate behind the crowded leader, though still unscorable and narrow-breadth (0.6).
theses.dissent: Breadth is only 0.6 and the rotation margin over the leader is thin (0.168); a mean-revert dip in the leader could leave Energy as a narrow, single-name-flush extension rather than a durable winner.

falsifier.text: Energy (H-shares) falls below High-Dividend Blue Chips on the next snapshot and its 30-day return lags the Hang Seng benchmark by 5% before the check-by date.

theses.subject: China Platform Megacaps
theses.thesis: This is the only scorable tech theme with an ETF proxy (3033.HK) and is ranked 13 with negative score, ineligible under the trend gate, and a mixed hurst tag; the gate_helps true history says avoiding ineligible, momentum-decaying themes is the one disciplined risk-control move.
theses.dissent: The theme is already discounting a lot of bad news; being underweight avoids downside rather than generating alpha, and a sharp relief rally on macro policy could whipsaw the look-through without a clear directional edge.

falsifier.text: China Platform Megacaps (via 3033.HK) outperforms the Hang Seng by 8% over the next 30 days, proving the underweight is too defensive for the regime.
